page.notes: Page is a three-column index; the entries are given as single lines in column order. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept where a word breaks. Doubtful: "institutio" (line end "in" / "ftitutio") is read as institutio [?]. "Serui auris manumitti nolentis" and "Sitara dormiens oppressus" are copied as printed. The small mark at the top left and the figures "18" and "y 2" at the foot are uncertain; the foot figures are treated as signature and catchword is omitted. The "mus 141" line at the head of the middle column is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is left as printed.
